Method: harvested from the sansad.in Lok Sabha Q&A index by subject keyword, then classified against the reportage scheme-regex map with its acronym-veto list. The API matches keywords as substrings of the subject line only, so questions whose subject names no scheme are not captured even if the answer discusses one. A mapping error is a classification bug, not a parliamentary fact.
